## Content checklist (content PRs only)

- [ ] Statement, examples, constraints, and tests are original.
- [ ] No LeetCode or other copyrighted content was copied.
- [ ] License and attribution fields are present.
- [ ] Python and TypeScript reference solutions pass every test.
- [ ] Tests are deterministic and independent.
- [ ] Hints do not reveal full code before level 4.
- [ ] A maintainer reviewed technical correctness.
- [ ] A reviewer checked clarity and ambiguity.

## Risk checklist

- [ ] No secrets, API keys, tokens, or personal paths in code/logs/fixtures.
- [ ] Renderer IPC input is validated; no new Node access.
- [ ] Offline behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Migrations are append-only and tested (if applicable).
- [ ] Accessibility basics are covered (if UI).
- [ ] `PROGRESS.md` is updated (if significant work).
- [ ] An ADR is added/updated (if the decision is expensive to change).
